verdict.rationale: BugSnag publishes an OpenAPI 3.0.3 spec for its Data Access API on SwaggerHub. The SmartBear developer portal hosts a reference generated from that spec, with per-operation pages plus authentication, pagination, rate-limiting and versioning docs, so an explorable API reference exists. The 404s on docs.bugsnag.com OpenAPI paths only show the spec lives elsewhere and do not contradict this. Missing for 10: explicit evidence of interactive try-it/runnable request execution in the reference, runnable code examples per operation, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
